ideas.name: AI Engineer Salary Surge
ideas.why: Median AI Engineer salary hit $185K in 2025 and total compensation topped $250K at top tech firms, reflecting record‑high demand for production‑oriented AI talent.
ideas.goal: Track salary benchmarks to gauge talent cost pressure and identify premium hiring markets.
